messages.author: 237a480cd1ff154f
messages.subject: Printing two things using renderPrint
parts:
I would like to display a table and the output of a chisq.test using renderPrint:

  output$sum <- renderPrint({
    s1 <- dataset(input$v1)
    s2 <- dataset(input$v2)
    table(s1,s2)
    chisq.test(s1,s2)
  })

This prints only the chisq.test result, and if I take this out, the table prints..  So far, I have not been able to print both.  Any help?

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Re: Printing two things using renderPrint
parts:
You can try ?capture.output

Create an objects for each of the two commands, then use cat() to print both.
You only need to figure out how to treat the end of line, it seems that it's not recognised by HTML (at least on my computer).

Hope this helps,
Adrian
